attackers_goals: An attacker may switch a valid account's password for persistence.
description: An attempt to unlock an Azure AD identity or reset its password has occurred.
detection_modules: Identity Threat Module, SaaS Threat Detection
investigative_actions: Check if the password reset is authorized. Check whether the user who reset the password is permitted to perform such actions. Check if the account is in the password reset group or is acting out of scope. Check whether the user has not completed the password reset and cancelled before successfully passing authentication methods. Follow further actions or suspicious logins from the target account.
name: Azure AD account unlock/password reset attempt

variations.name: Azure AD account unlock/successful password reset
variations.description: An identity successfully reset or changed Azure AD password.
